feeds.name: Buses urbanos de Cuenca (Morlaco)
feeds.description: Urban bus lines of Cuenca, Ecuador, built by the Morlaco open data project from the Cuenca city government's open data portal (Cuenca en Datos): routes and frequencies (2025), route shapes (2022) and registered stops. Frequency-based feed with estimated travel times; not an official feed from the city or EMOV EP.
